sql: SELECT TOP 10 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (@orderStatus IS NULL OR s.StatusCode = UPPER(@orderStatus)) THEN o.OrderId END) AS orderCount, CONCAT(o.UserId, MIN(CASE WHEN (@orderStatus IS NULL OR s.StatusCode = UPPER(@orderStatus)) THEN o.ClassNumber END), MAX(CASE WHEN (@orderStatus IS NULL OR s.StatusCode = UPPER(@orderStatus)) THEN o.ClassNumber END), COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (@orderStatus IS NULL OR s.StatusCode = UPPER(@orderStatus)) THEN o.OrderId END)) AS countScope FROM dbo.ZnodeOrder o INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeCPOrderClass oc ON oc.CPOrderClassId = o.ClassId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal po ON po.PortalId = o.PortalId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodeOmsOrderState s ON s.OmsOrderStateId = o.OmsOrderStateId WHERE oc.ClassCode = @orderClass AND po.StoreCode = @store AND (@owner IS NULL OR o.UserId = @owner) GROUP BY o.UserId, o.PortalId HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.OrderId) >= @minOrders AND (@maxOrders IS NULL OR COUNT(DISTINCT o.OrderId) <= @maxOrders) AND (@minOrdersInStatus IS NULL OR COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (@orderStatus IS NULL OR s.StatusCode = UPPER(@orderStatus)) THEN o.OrderId END) >= @minOrdersInStatus) ORDER BY MIN(o.ClassNumber)
